milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining blue wool drops the blue_wool item into the player's inventory. The player starts with 0 blue_wool (only a wooden_axe is given). The 3x3x3 blue wool cube at (+3 to +5, 0 to +2, +3 to +5) must be mined to both complete this task and to physically access the hidden chest inside containing blue dye for the next task. Any tool (or bare hand) can break wool, and it always drops itself.

Uses inventory_has to check for emerald because selling blue dye to the shepherd villager yields 1 emerald per 12 blue dye traded. The player starts with 0 emeralds and the only source of emeralds in this scene is the villager trade. The chest inside the wool cube contains exactly 12 blue dye (enough for one trade). Successfully completing the trade is the only way to obtain an emerald, making this a reliable completion signal for the 'sell' action.
